name: mirage
text: Seen both screenshots. They were taken on the old runner whose Novig read was stuck on the slow route, so the Novig line, 'Last scan 11 min ago' and the trading note were all that run's last words, repeated rather than refreshed. I'm now checking how the Engine tab refreshes and will make every card show its own age and drop or grey out anything old, and make the pull read everything fresh. I'll report when it's built.
